verdict.rationale: Statsig documents its own client and server SDKs, which log exposures and get data flowing with a few lines of code. It also offers an HTTP API for logging events without an SDK. The pack never lists the supported languages or platforms, never mentions mobile SDKs, and never documents a custom event-logging call by name. missing for 10: an enumerated list of official SDKs across major languages, explicit mobile SDK support, documented SDK event-logging methods, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can send events from web, mobile, and backend apps through official SDKs for the major languages and platforms

citations.quote: How to call checkGate in Statsig client and server SDKs to evaluate a feature gate, including parameters, return values, and exposure logging.
